build.definition: build_seconds is a clean build of BM25 + vector + hybrid; index_peak_alloc_mb is a SECOND build under tracemalloc (which slows the build, so its time is not reported)

cold_start.definition: cold_start_total_ms = fresh `python -c` process wall time for imports + corpus load + index build; cold_start_work_ms is the in-child measurement of load+build only; interpreter_baseline_ms is `python -c pass` on the same machine. status=failed means the child process failed and every number beside it is null.

run_conditions.note: timings are host-dependent; the budget check is against the stated numbers
